reader.requirement: At --std 85, OPEN INPUT of a SELECT OPTIONAL indexed file that is not present must succeed (05) and leave the file position indicator saying 'optional input file not present', so the first format 1 READ is at end (10) and a START or format 2 READ is invalid key (23), in every access mode, without creating the file. The witness covers dynamic access START and READ NEXT only.

edition-consulted.switches: bakes --std (85) into each connector's registration (FileConnector.Edition); no rule of this case reads it except the gates listed

reader.edition-search: grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior' over KeyedConnector.OpenCore's Input arm, FileConnector.SequentialReadGuard and RandomReadAbsentOptionalGuard: none; SELECT OPTIONAL on an indexed file compiles at 85 with no gate
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: p4optabs printed identical lines at 85 and 2023 (p4optabs-002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_optional_input_absent covers dynamic access (START 23, READ NEXT 10); sequential access, random access, the KEY phrase READ, the 46 after the first at end and 'not created' for indexed are not exercised (probed here)

probes.printed: sequential: OPEN 05, READ at end 10, second READ 46, re-OPEN 05 (not created), START 23; random: OPEN 05, READ 23, READ 23, READ KEY IS alternate 23; dynamic: OPEN 05, READ NEXT 10, random READ 23 then READ NEXT 46, START 23; no data file in the run directory
probes.expected: 05 at OPEN, first sequential READ at end 10, START/random READ 23 (READ GR9), a READ after the at end 46, no file created

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR9  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9  ["sets the file position indicator to indicate that an optional input file is not present"]
OK  §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR10  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10  ["or that an optional input file is not present"]
OK  §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR9  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9  ["the invalid key condition exists and execution of the READ statement is unsuccessful"]
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.1d  ["An OPEN statement is successfully executed but the referenced optional file is not present"]
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.2a.2  ["A sequential READ statement is attempted for the first time on an optional input file that is not present"]
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3c.2  ["A START or random READ statement is attempted on an optional input file that is not present"]
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5e.3  ["The preceding READ statement caused an at end condition"]

reader.notes: KeyedConnector.OpenCore's Input arm sets OptionalAbsent and answers 05 without creating the file; the shared guards turn that state into 10 (first sequential READ) and 23 (random READ, START), and the unsuccessful READ arms 46 for its successor as 1985's 46 item 3 requires.

refuter.evidence: Probe q2misc-001: SELECT OPTIONAL absent indexed, dynamic: OPEN INPUT 05, START with no INVALID KEY: USE runs with 23, then READ NEXT 46 (START unsuccessful, IX.1.3.4 46 item 1); format 2 READ with no INVALID KEY: USE runs with 23. Sequential: OPEN 05, READ with no AT END: USE runs with 10 (IX.4.5.4 GR10c); READ with AT END: AT END runs and USE does not (GR10b); CLOSE 00. cite: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR9 [sets the file position indicator to indicate that an optional input file is not present]; OK §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR10c [a USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure must be associated with the file connector].
